scope: Fail-closed full-video articulated-hand, metric-contact, force-closure, and causal flower-motion audit of the 27.5-second hand-union candidate
summary: The 660-frame candidate fails causal flower response in 9 of 329 projected contact-driver frames, lacks the metric and articulated evidence required for 3-D contact or force closure, and remains rejected by high-resolution human review.
evidence: The immutable audit decodes 660/660 frames at 624x352 and 24 FPS and processes them in 13.657255958 seconds at 48.325959624 FPS on the local CPU.
Background-noise-derived motion floors are 0.651925 pixels/frame for the hand and 0.325963 pixels/frame for the flower support; no failed interaction was used to fit its own threshold.
Nine of 329 projected contact-driver frames have no flower response within two frames: 60, 88--91, 126, 136--137, and 219; the longest run is four frames.

Missing calibrated metric camera, surface gaps, depth source, occlusion order, contact force, external/support wrench, articulated metric joint sequence, and full per-stem identity are explicit hard failures.
Response-erasure, missing-depth/force spoof, and broken-parent-tree adversarial attacks are all detected.
Fifteen focused contact, force-closure, audit, and evolution tests pass and targeted Ruff checks pass.
lessons: Treating flowers as immutable protected background can preserve appearance while suppressing manipulation dynamics.
Observed force equilibrium is not force closure; the latter also needs a full-rank 6-D frictional grasp-wrench positive-span certificate.
Image-space hand/flower adjacency and optical flow are useful rejection proxies but cannot prove metric depth, occlusion order, contact, or force.
limitations: The visual causal audit uses a union flower mask and optical flow and cannot assign every interaction to a physical stem.
The only named active-stem track covers 17 sparse samples over source frames 272--320.
No newly generated or rendered fixed video was produced, and full-resolution finger/contact review remains rejected.
next_actions: Acquire or reconstruct a reviewed metric camera/scene, robot joint trajectory, per-stem 3-D centerlines, and calibrated or simulator-derived contact/support wrenches before running a new 660-frame candidate.
